title: Materialize MiniMax H3 hosted/hybrid adapter, executable admission and current-host E2E evidence path
decisions: The first production execution target is the hosted MiniMax H3 path because it can be admitted independently from the H3 open-weight territorial license gate.
The hosted adapter projects canonical VideoGenerationIR into MiniMax H3 provider requests and normalizes provider results back into FA3 evidence; it does not become a router or context authority.
Credential class is explicit and secrets are neither logged nor persisted in evidence.
A real provider task accepted and completed for MiniMax-H3 proves requested-operation entitlement for that execution; dynamic limits remain provider observations, not canonical constants.
Current-host production E2E is billable and therefore may run only through explicit manual workflow acknowledgement.
Missing credential, terms admission or entitlement produces PENDING_EXTERNAL_ADMISSION and cannot be promoted.
Local or hybrid H3-Base execution is denied without explicit local H3 license/territory authorization evidence; no local runtime PASS is claimed by this materialization.
A production receipt requires real downloaded video, SHA-256 identity, video+audio QC, latency evidence and provenance.
Static prices are not encoded into the adapter or receipt because MiniMax pricing is mutable provider metadata.
